request: Improve search-engine crawling and machine-readable documentation; maintainer explicitly selected CC BY 4.0 for project-original documentation text.
finding: Review pages were incorrectly excluded from search-engine indexing by a shared noindex rule. VitePress already produced static HTML with the complete article.
changes: Allow indexing for complete review and published pages without changing editorial status or hardware verification claims.
Retain noindex for drafts, redirects, and 404; canonicalize old release redirects to the maintained target.
Generate sitemap.xml with eligible language alternatives and Git modification dates; allow public crawling through robots.txt.
Add canonical, reciprocal eligible hreflang, matching x-default fallback, social metadata, and WebSite/CollectionPage/TechArticle/BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.

Generate a concise llms.txt, complete language indexes, and 108 clean Markdown copies from the same source pages; expand attachments and shared code includes, make links absolute, and preserve review and archive context.

Apply CC BY 4.0 to project-original documentation text as authorized, preserving individual contributor copyright and explicitly excluding third-party text, media, diagrams, firmware, code, and downloads.
Document contribution licensing and crawler/indexing maintenance; add eligibility, exporter, and built-output checks to npm run check.
limitations: Crawl permission does not guarantee search indexing, rankings, live AI citations, or selection for model training.
llms.txt is a discovery proposal, not a Google Search ranking requirement.
No Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools ownership verification or sitemap submission was performed in this change.
Documentation-text licensing does not grant rights to third-party assets or software, nor transfer contributor copyright.
Hardware, paid-service, and community verification scopes remain unchanged.
